run.description: Problem 9 full run: working DB reset, then tickets 101, 102, 103 run on the board in order, then human approvals on the dashboard.
run.model: gpt-6-luna (every agent, via Portkey; every response reported gpt-6-luna-global)

tickets.subject: Bulldog tee for Tauhid Zaman (1 x CC-TEE-WHITE, size S)
tickets.outcome: Size S was out of stock and the only apparel vendor (Bulldog Print Co) was blocked by overdue invoice 501. The team queued invoice 501 ($840) and a 1-unit reprint PO ($8) for approval, and saved an honest draft to Tauhid with no firm date. After human approval, invoice 501 is paid and the tee is expected about 2026-09-05.

agents.boss: Routed Inventory, then Accounting, then Customer Service (Facilities not needed); made the final call; set the ticket to resolved with update_ticket_status.
agents.inventory: check_stock showed 0 on hand (shortfall 1); list_vendors showed Bulldog Print Co (5-day lead) blocked by invoice 501; get_product_pricing showed $8 unit cost.
agents.accounting: Checked cash ($3,400), invoice 501 (3 days overdue) and the upcoming rent; created request #1 (invoice 501, $840), request #2 (rent, $2,400, queued early for ticket 102) and request #3 (PO for 1 tee, $8).
agents.customer_service: Saved draft #1 to Tauhid Zaman: size S unavailable today, September 5 only a conditional earliest estimate. Not sent.

human_approvals.what: Purchase order, 1 x CC-TEE-WHITE size S, Bulldog Print Co (expected arrival 2026-09-05)

tickets.subject: Rent notice from Elm City Properties (lease 1)
tickets.outcome: Facilities confirmed the lease: $2,400 due 2026-09-02 (2 days away, upcoming). Rent was already queued as request #2 during ticket 101, so no duplicate was created. After human approval, rent is paid and lease 1's next_due moved to 2026-10-02.

agents.boss: Checked the desk date, routed Facilities, then Accounting; set the ticket to resolved.
agents.accounting: get_cash_position and list_payment_requests: confirmed request #2 already pending, and that all pending requests ($3,248) leave $152, so no new request was needed.
agents.facilities: get_lease_rent_due(1): $2,400 due 2026-09-02, 2 days out; list_payment_requests: rent already pending, not paid.
agents.customer_service: Not called (the landlord didn't need a reply).

tickets.subject: Bulk hoodie discount for the Yale AI Club (20 x CC-HOOD-NAVY, size M)
tickets.outcome: Offer $48 each ($960 for 20, 17.2% off list, 54.2% margin). Only 8 are in stock; the other 12 can't be committed because a $264 restock would exceed the cash left after pending payments by $112. No purchase order was created. A draft to the club is on the board.

agents.boss: Routed Inventory, then Accounting, then Customer Service (Facilities not needed); decided the $48 offer with 8 now; set the ticket to resolved.
agents.inventory: check_stock: 8 on hand, shortfall 12; list_vendors: Bulldog Print Co (5-day lead) blocked by invoice 501; get_product_pricing: $22 cost, $58 list.
agents.accounting: check_margin at $48 (54.2% margin, 17.2% off) and $44 (50.0% margin floor, 24.1% off); checked cash and upcoming rent (get_lease_rent_due); found the 12-unit restock ($264) unaffordable ($152 left), so no PO.
agents.facilities: Not called (Accounting checked the rent figure itself).
agents.customer_service: Saved draft #2 to the Yale AI Club: $48 each, 8 can be filled now, the remaining 12 not yet confirmed. Not sent.
